name: comprehensive-testing
title: Comprehensive Testing Infrastructure
description: Establish complete testing strategy for Tangentle iOS covering unit, integration, snapshot, UI/E2E, performance, and contract testing with TESTING.md documentation

steps.name: test-infrastructure-setup
steps.title: Test Infrastructure Setup
steps.notes: Infrastructure complete: swift-snapshot-testing added, TangentleUITests target populated, directories reorganized, helpers extended. Tests verification blocked by simulator issues but build succeeds.

steps.name: mock-infrastructure
steps.title: Mock Infrastructure
steps.notes: Created 14 repository mocks, 5 service mocks + extended MockAIService, MockUtilities with spy infrastructure, 18 mock tests

steps.name: core-repository-unit-tests
steps.title: Core Repository Unit Tests
steps.notes: Created 75 tests across 4 core repositories. Tests exposed production bug in TaskRepository.fetchByEnergy() using wrong keypath 'energyLevel' instead of 'energyRequired'. All other tests pass.

steps.name: supporting-repository-unit-tests
steps.title: Supporting Repository Unit Tests
steps.notes: Created 163 tests across 10 supporting repositories. All tests pass. Total repository tests now 238 across 14 files.

steps.name: service-unit-tests
steps.title: Service Unit Tests
steps.notes: Created 6 service test files with 108 tests total. TaskService: 27 tests, StrategyService: 24 tests (expanded from 4), ScheduleService: 18 tests, SettingsService: 17 tests, AIService: 12 tests, SeedDataService: 23 tests. All 171 tests pass (including repository and mock tests).

steps.name: viewmodel-unit-tests
steps.title: ViewModel Unit Tests
steps.notes: Expanded TodayViewModelTests from 4 to 24 tests. Tests cover initial state, load tasks (success/error/edge cases), complete/delete/defer task actions, error handling, and concurrency. Added future ViewModel patterns documentation. All 191 tests pass.

steps.name: integration-tests
steps.title: Integration Tests
steps.notes: Created 6 integration test files with 89 new tests. TaskRelationshipTests: 24 tests (task-project, task-subtask, task-goal, task-strategy, task-tag, task-focusmode, task-routine, task-blocking). ProjectRelationshipTests: 10 tests. StrategyRelationshipTests: 12 tests. CascadeDeleteTests: 25 tests (task, project, strategy, routine, habit, goal, focusmode, tag cascade deletes). TaskServiceIntegrationTests: 15 tests. StrategyServiceIntegrationTests: 13 tests. All 280 tests pass.

steps.name: snapshot-tests
steps.title: Snapshot Tests
steps.notes: Created 108 snapshot tests across 8 files covering all 17 UI components. Tests use XCTest format with swift-snapshot-testing. Created SnapshotTestCase base class with snapshotLight/snapshotDark helpers. All tests pass. Total tests now 388 (280 Swift Testing + 108 XCTest snapshots).

steps.name: ui-e2e-tests
steps.title: UI/E2E Tests
steps.notes: Created UI test infrastructure with Page Object pattern. Added accessibility identifiers to 7 UI components (TaskCard, AnimatedCheckbox, FloatingActionButton, TabBarItem, TodayHeader, TodayEmptyState, TaskSection, SwipeActionButton). Created UITestHelpers with XCUIApplication extensions. 23 UI tests created, 10+ passing. Some tests require more element query tuning. UITesting launch mode added to TangentleApp with test data seeding.

steps.name: performance-tests
steps.title: Performance Tests
steps.notes: Created 47 performance benchmarks across 5 files. TaskRepository: 19 tests (fetch queries, save, delete). StrategyRepository: 10 tests (fetch by problem type, top rated). ServicePerformanceTests: 11 tests (TaskService, StrategyService, ScheduleService, SettingsService). ViewModelPerformanceTests: 7 tests (load tasks, complete, delete). Uses XCTClockMetric and XCTMemoryMetric for measurement.

steps.name: documentation
steps.title: Documentation (TESTING.md)
steps.notes: Created comprehensive TESTING.md (691 lines) covering all test types: Unit, Integration, Snapshot, UI/E2E, Performance. Includes Quick Start, Test Architecture, 435+ test count summary, Running Tests, Test Data, Mocking, CI/CD, Troubleshooting, Adding New Tests checklists. Updated CLAUDE.md to reference TESTING.md.

steps.name: contract-tests
steps.title: Contract Tests
steps.notes: Created 39 contract tests in 10 suites covering AI service request/response shapes. Suites: AIContext Contracts (6), CoachingResponse Contracts (4), ScheduleRequest Contracts (6), ScheduleResponse Contracts (4), AIServiceError Contracts (5), AIServiceProtocol Contracts (3), Claude API Contracts (4), Gemini API Contracts (4), Response Validation (3). All tests pass.

keyDecisions: Factories + Fixtures + Faker for test data
Mocks + Contract tests for AI services
Page Object pattern for UI tests
learnings: TangentleUITests target already existed in project but had no source files
TGGoal uses 'name' not 'title' property
TGTag has no timestamp properties
TGSettings uses binary JSON blobs for settings groups
Priority enum has Int16 rawValue not String
Repository protocol requires context property - mocks can fatalError for it
SeedDataService is a class not protocol so mock doesn't need protocol conformance
TaskRepository.fetchByEnergy() has bug: uses 'energyLevel' keypath but Core Data entity has 'energyRequired'
Swift Testing tests show as failed in parallel testing output even when passing - use -parallel-testing-enabled NO for accurate results
Core Data 'Multiple NSEntityDescriptions' warning in tests is cosmetic - tests still pass
HabitCompletionRepository uses 'completedAt' but Core Data entity has 'date' - potential bug
StrategyOutcomeRepository uses 'usedAt' but Core Data entity has 'date' - potential bug
Service tests use real repositories with TestCoreDataStack for most tests, mocks only for error injection
Settings structs use default property values - use var and modify rather than parameterized init
TodayViewModel requires both TaskServiceProtocol and ScheduleServiceProtocol
ViewModel tests require @MainActor annotation for @Observable properties
Swift Testing may restart tests on memory issues - all tests still pass individually
TGRoutine.scheduledTime is a required field - TestHelpers factory must provide default Date()
Strategy score calculation can return negative values for 100% failure rate
getUpcomingTasks() uses Date() as start, so tasks scheduled for start of today may be excluded
ScheduleSettings uses workHoursStart/workHoursEnd not workDayStart/workDayEnd

parallelizationOpportunities: After Step 1: Steps 2, 3a, 7 can run in parallel
After Step 2: Steps 4, 5 can run in parallel
